contract: Opaque selection IDs are serialization-local to a materialized Trajectory Variant. Sequential first-use allocation and validation are preserved.
invariant: Within one materialized variant: opaque selection ID + source owner -> stable locator -> exactly one physical entity.
across_variants: A in [A,B] and A in [B,A] may carry different opaque IDs. This alone is not a correctness regression.
valid_equivalent_variant_requirements: same Source Sample and causal input geometry
same physical selected entities and owner binding
mechanically equivalent action outputs under authoritative STEP/geometry comparison
collision_status: Recording rejects owner-local locator ambiguity before kernel execution; reconstruction already rejects ambiguous matches.
